verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for expense-management software, but nothing in the pack documents a single action applied to many items at once. The Integration Server API (expensify-docs-23) and plain-language AI commands for creating or approving expenses (expensify-docs-3) are developer building blocks or per-item actions. Auto-submit, auto-approve and auto-export flows (expensify-docs-27, expensify-docs-31, expensify-docs-34) are adjacent policy automation, not user-initiated bulk operations, so the reviewer's concern holds and none of this earns credit.
